title: Removed companion projects come back after restart
objective: A project removed from the companion's project list stays removed across companion restarts, and every other saved project is kept.
goal: Removing a project with "Remove from list" in the companion's project menu works until the companion restarts; after a restart the removed project is listed again. Make a removal persist across restarts while every other saved project, including one added after the removal, stays listed.
criteria: A project removed from the list is not listed after a companion restart.
Every other saved project, including one added again after its removal, is still listed after a restart.
The starting project still cannot be removed, and the saved list keeps its format and private file permissions.
out_of_scope: Restoring the last selected project after a restart.
notes: Start the companion with `cd ui && npm start -- --workspace /absolute/project --socket /absolute/private/dir/none.sock`; it prints a private local URL, and the private `--socket` path keeps a manual check away from any live Herdr server.

The project list is saved to `$XDG_STATE_HOME/docket-ui/projects.json` (default `~/.local/state/docket-ui/projects.json`); use a private `XDG_STATE_HOME` and disposable projects for any manual check, never real companion state.

Prerequisites: Node.js 22+ and Python 3.11+ as `python3`. The companion's npm dependencies are already installed in `ui/node_modules` and the machine may be offline, so do not reinstall, update or remove them.
